slides.title: Running a PT clinic in December: expectation vs reality
Expectation: helping patients hit their goals.
slides.body: Reality: figuring out whose CPR card expires first.

slides.title: Expectation: "the policy renews itself."
slides.body: Reality: the renewal notice went to an old email.

slides.title: Fix the one you can.
slides.body: Write down every license, CPR card and policy date before January does it for you.
